svg.title: Which file changes which part of the PDF
svg.desc: Which project file changes which part of the PDF. Five files on the left each point to a part of main.pdf on the right. metadata.tex sets the title page: your title, name, and degree. main.tex sets the order of the chapters, as the contents show. The files in chapters/ hold your words. references.bib and preamble.tex set the reference list and the citation style. rpi-thesis.cls sets the formatting of every page, drawn as a dashed frame around the whole PDF; it is normally never edited.
svg.text: which file changes which part of the PDF
sets the formatting of every page
